soap.subjective: Patient reports fatigue, polydipsia, polyuria, and 12 lbs unintentional weight loss over the past month. Nocturnal foot tingling and numbness bilaterally. Family history: mother with type 2 diabetes. Diet high in fast food, sedentary lifestyle.
soap.objective: BMI 34. Blood pressure 142/88. Finger stick glucose 310. HbA1c 10.2%. Fundoscopic exam reveals early background retinopathy. Monofilament test: decreased sensation bilaterally up to ankle.

assessment.summary: New diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus with poor glycemic control (A1c 10.2%), complicated by peripheral neuropathy and early retinopathy. Comorbid hypertension.

icd10_codes.description: Type 2 diabetes mellitus with diabetic neuropathy, unspecified
Type 2 diabetes mellitus with unspecified diabetic retinopathy without macular edema

plan.instructions: Monitor glucose before meals and at bedtime. Target fasting glucose 80-130. Daily foot inspection. Referral to ophthalmology, diabetes educator, and dietitian. Urine microalbumin ordered.
plan.follow_up: 3-month follow-up for A1c recheck and medication titration
